request.style: English, Sacred Harp fuguing tune, a loud rugged four-part congregation, the parts entering one after another in the second half of every verse, no instruments, major key with open fifths, driving and hopeful, 4/4, 104 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
On Nebo's height old Moses stood
And looked on Canaan's land
The Lord showed him the promised good
Laid out on every hand

[Verse]
The priests went down to Jordan's flood
The ark upon their shoulders high
The waters stood up where they stood
And Israel passed by dry

[Verse]
So when I come to Jordan's side
And hear the waters roar
The Lord will part the swelling tide
And lead me safely o'er

[Verse]
Then I shall stand on Canaan's ground
And see the promised land
Where milk and honey flow around
At God's own right hand
